During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''cantina''' catered to members of several [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. At one point, a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was present at the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="GH">''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook]]''</ref>
